description: Comptages routiers is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. Données des postes de comptage de la circulation routière nationaux, cantonaux ou de tiers ainsi que les valeurs mesurées associées (trafic journalier moyen, pourcentage de poids lourds, etc.). Les données de trafic relevées dans le cadre des campagnes cantonales quinquennales de comptage sont aussi intégrées. Coverage: Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. The portal files it under the publisher Geoinformation Kanton Freiburg. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
